notes_for_editor: Thin record. Every source here is a lookout list or site page; firelookout.com and the Forest Service list both draw on the same Kamstra and Forest Service records, so they are not independent confirmation of the 1933 date. No staffing history (the Idaho site says none is documented, left out of the story), no photo, and no access rules were found. The 12.2 m height is the 40-foot pole height as given, not checked against a measurement. Elevation 4,697 ft is from the Forest Service list and the Idaho site, not entered as a fact field.
